description: This file contains a test case class for testing decorators and scripting functions with PyTorch's JIT compiler. It defines a test class TestDecorator that verifies the behavior of a function decorated with custom decorators by using torch.jit.script, and contains a main guard that raises an error if run directly.

classes.name: TestDecorator
classes.description: A test case class derived from JitTestCase to verify function scripting with TorchScript.

methods.name: test_decorator(self)
methods.description: Tests that a decorated function can be scripted with torch.jit.script() and that its output matches the original function.
